webhooks.detail: No webhooks or event subscriptions mentioned in Consensus llms.txt / llms-full.txt. docs.consensus.app returned 403 to automated fetch, so unverified.

evidence.quote: Sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` on every request

sandbox.detail: Free plan exists (limited, for evaluation; MCP anonymous tier for trying). REST API keys are issued from an organization subscription page. No sandbox/test mode documented.

evidence.quote: Free: anonymous and lightly authenticated access for evaluation and casual use

rate_limits.summary: REST limits per org plan (numbers on docs/pricing, not seen); 429 + Retry-After on exceed; MCP per-plan table (Free: 1 QPS per user)

evidence.quote: REST API limits depend on the organization plan; consult https://docs.consensus.app for the current per-plan request quotas.
Access tiers: anonymous (limited), Free, Pro, Team, and Enterprise.
